verdict.rationale: Luma's legacy Dream Machine API reference embeds per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 JSON definitions in the .md mirror of each reference page, so a machine-readable spec exists in fragments. However, no standalone downloadable spec file exists: probes of openapi.json, swagger.json and well-known paths all return 404. The OpenAPI blocks also cover only the generation the vendor labels legacy, and nothing shows a spec for the current Luma Agents API. Missing for 10: a single downloadable OpenAPI/equivalent file, spec coverage of the current Agents API, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Luma's legacy Dream Machine API reference publishes per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 definitions in the markdown mirror of every reference page (each .md carries an "# OpenAPI definition" block with the operation's full JSON)
Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.
